title: SW pull failure
sourceDocs: DTP TS tickets via Glean, Jul–Oct 2026

options.label: Right away, within about a minute
Says failed, but it may still be running

sp_ticket.text: Check the VO ticket's software and route fields
steps: Open the VO ticket for this mission.
Confirm it has a Shipyard release or build in the expected format.
Confirm the Atlas view and goal list fields match the route exactly (format matters).
If something is missing or wrong, dispatch or the ticket owner has to fix it. Note what you found.
sp_ticket.help: Most fast failures in past tickets were ticket setup problems, not the truck.

sp_still.text: Let it finish before pulling again
steps: Give it a few minutes and re-check the deploy status.
sp_still.help: Scout has shown 'SW Pull Failed' while the deploy kept running and then finished.

sp_long.text: Does it say to reach out to technical support?
sp_long.help: Long installs that timed out returned DEPLOY_FAILED_GET_TECHNICAL_SUPPORT. One GRPC failure at 31 minutes was cleared by a cold start and re-pull.

sp_cs.help: A pull that died late with a communication error re-pulled fine after a cold start (DTP-112058).

steps: Start the software pull one more time.

sp_esc.text: Operator-level SW pull steps are used up. Open a TS ticket and paste the handoff.
sp_esc.handoffNote: Past causes: VO ticket missing or misformatted Shipyard release / Atlas view (dispatch fix); deploy timeouts or GRPC errors (cold start + re-pull); Scout showing failed while the deploy was still running.
